title: Signal store module file
description: One <module>.json of a vehicle pack's signal store (src/<pack>/signals/): the LID field mappings that the decoders, the dashboard and automap read. Written only through openostler.signals.upsert_field (CONSTITUTION). Custom keys must start with x-.

name.description: Field id within the module, e.g. coolant_temp.

lid.description: Local identifier: two or more hex digits ("1A"), or an integer.

offset.description: Byte offset in the LID's data.

unit.description: Display unit as stored by the pack.

confidence.description: proven = verified against the car; candidate = derived or unverified (ADR-0006).

states.description: Raw value (as a decimal string key) to a state label.

length.description: Applies only to a data field of exactly this many bytes (reply-length layouts).

metric.description: The canonical meaning: a COVESA VSS path known to openostler.metrics (ADR-0016). Optional.

primary.description: This module's field is the primary source of its metric when more than one module maps the same VSS path (module-bus spec v1.3 §6, owner answer 9): the node publishes vss/<VSS path> only from it and the other modules' readings under their pack leaves. Packs write it only as true (absent = not primary; false is accepted and means not primary), on every record of the field, length variants included; at most one module per path.
